dropped.title: Failed requests to Partner scoring API are lost
dropped.message: Partner scoring API fails some of what it's sent, and nothing delivers it again: there's no queue or topic in front of it to redeliver.
dropped.rationale: A message that fails where nothing can deliver it again, or that runs out of deliveries with no dead-letter route, is gone. Whether that happens depends on the traffic and the failures a simulation plays, so only playing it shows where, and how many.

findings.title: Dead letters pile up in Dead letters
findings.message: Nothing in the diagram reads or alerts on Dead letters: failed messages stay there until someone looks.

fix.label: Add a reader…
fix.needsChoice: Pick what reads Dead letters, then add it and connect dlq to it.
